verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents that you can configure the equation that calculates customer risk scores, and you can create multiple configurations and pick one per customer. That gives some business-specific tailoring of scoring. Nothing shows the model accepting developer-supplied signals such as device fingerprints, behavioral data or arbitrary custom metadata as scoring inputs, and Starter Plan configurations cannot be customized at all. missing for 10: documented ingestion of custom signals (device fingerprints, behavioral data, custom metadata) into the risk score, API-level detail on custom risk-factor inputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
